resources.string: To turn on %1$s, FocusShield needs Accessibility access to protect against %2$s during focus sessions.
On-device only. FocusShield never records keystrokes, personal information or screen content.
Fix a greyed-out or restricted setting

If the phone shows “Restricted setting: for your security, this setting is currently unavailable”:
• Tap “Open App info” below
• Tap the three-dot menu in the top corner
• Choose “Allow restricted settings”
• Return here and turn on Accessibility

If the service turns off when the app closes:
• Open App info and allow Autostart
• Set Battery saver to No restrictions
• Keep FocusShield in the recent apps list
2. Open App info to allow restricted settings
